add_insurance.description: Action where the user adds insurance to a booking.

ask_destination.description: The agent asks the user for the trip destination.

ask_origin.description: The agent asks the user for the trip origin.

ask_travel_insurance.description: The agent asks the user about purchasing travel insurance.

ask_trip_type.description: The agent asks the user for the trip type.

asks_question_about_payment_or_refund.description: The agent asks a question about the payment or refund method.

booking_blocked.description: Booking is blocked due to policy.

cancel_entire_trip.description: The agent may cancel the entire trip, discarding all remaining segments.

certificate_amount_equals_100usd_per_pas.description: Set the certificate amount to 100 USD per passenger.

certificate_total_amount_50_times_passen.description: Action to set the total certificate amount to 50 times the number of passengers when the 50x policy applies.

collect_passenger_details.description: Agent collects the passenger's first name, last name, and date of birth.

complete_booking.description: Action to finalize the reservation booking.

credit_card_payment_made.description: An event indicating that a payment was made using a credit card for the current reservation.

deny_request.description: Action to deny or block the user request.

entitlement_silver_basic_economy_1.description: Entitlement granting one free checked bag for silver members traveling in basic economy.

full_refund_granted_for_booking.description: A full refund has been granted for the specified booking.

gesture_certificate_offered.description: Gesture certificate has been offered to the user.

initiate_tool_call.description: Agent initiates a tool call in the current time step.

modify_flight_api_call_made.description: The agent has performed (made) the API call to modify a flight.

offer_travel_insurance_at_price_30_usd_p.description: The agent offers the travel insurance option at a price of 30 USD per passenger.

payment_for_reservation_completed_succes.description: The payment transaction for the reservation completed successfully.

payment_for_reservation_started.description: A payment transaction for a reservation has started (or is in progress).

payment_method_provided_for_changed_flig.description: A payment method has been provided for the changed flight (e.g., gift card or credit card).

provide_information.description: The agent provides information in response to a query or task.

refund_denied.description: The refund for the travel certificate's remaining balance is denied.

refund_initiated.description: A refund has been initiated for a customer.

remove_checked_bag.description: Action where a checked bag is removed from the flight order.

respond_to_user.description: Agent provides a response to the user in the current time step.

transfer_to_human.description: The agent transfers the user to a human agent for assistance.

travel_certificate_applied_to_current_re.description: An action where the agent applies a travel certificate to the current reservation's payment.

update_booking_action.description: Merged action representing any update to the booking database (flight booking, passenger details, segments, times, core details).

update_price_based_on_current_price.description: Action where the system updates the price of a flight segment using the current price.

uses_payment_method.description: The agent selects or attempts to use a specific payment method for a transaction.

rule_list.description: Information can be provided only when the source is the user or an available tool.
predicates: The agent provides information in response to a query or task.
The information source is either the user or an available tool used by the agent.

rule_list.description: Subjective recommendations must never be provided.
Mutual exclusivity: a tool call and a user response cannot occur in the same time step.
predicates: Agent initiates a tool call in the current time step.
Agent provides a response to the user in the current time step.

rule_list.description: Prevent consecutive tool calls: only one tool call can be initiated in adjacent time steps.
predicates: Agent initiates a tool call in the current time step.

rule_list.description: Deny any user request that violates the Airline Agent Policy.
predicates: The user's current request violates the Airline Agent Policy.
Action to deny or block the user request.

rule_list.description: The agent must obtain the user ID before asking for the trip type.
predicates: The agent must obtain the user ID before asking for the trip type.

rule_list.description: Each extra baggage costs 50 dollars.
predicates: Each extra baggage incurs a cost of 50 dollars.

rule_list.description: During the booking upsell phase, the agent must eventually offer the travel insurance option at a price of 30 dollars per passenger.
predicates: The system is currently in the upsell phase of the booking process.
The agent offers the travel insurance option at a price of 30 USD per passenger.

rule_list.description: If a flight segment is kept, the price must not be updated based on the current price.
predicates: Indicates that a flight segment is retained in the itinerary (not removed).
Action where the system updates the price of a flight segment using the current price.

rule_list.description: Policy ensures that if the agent asks a question, the topic is the payment or refund method.
predicates: The agent asks a question about the payment or refund method.
The agent's question concerns the payment or refund method.

rule_list.description: If the booking is within 24 hours, cancellation is permitted due to the 24-hour window.
predicates: The current time is within 24 hours of the booking time.
Cancellation is allowed because the booking is within 24 hours.

rule_list.description: After the certificate offer is triggered, compute/apply the total certificate amount as $50 per passenger.
predicates: The conditions to offer a certificate have been met.
Total certificate amount equals $50 times the number of passengers in the reservation.

rule_list.description: The agent must not ask for the origin before asking for the trip type.
predicates: The agent asks the user for the trip type.
The agent asks the user for the trip origin.

rule_list.description: The agent must not ask for the destination before asking for the origin.
predicates: The agent asks the user for the trip origin.
The agent asks the user for the trip destination.

rule_list.description: During the booking upsell phase, the agent must eventually ask the user about travel insurance.
predicates: The system is currently in the upsell stage of the booking process.
The agent asks the user about purchasing travel insurance.

rule_list.description: Once the trip type has been provided, the agent should ask for the origin.
predicates: The user has provided a trip type (e.g., business, leisure).
The agent asks the user for the trip origin.

rule_list.description: After a flight change, the user must provide a payment method for the changed flight.
predicates: A flight change has been initiated or applied for the passenger's itinerary.
A payment method has been provided for the changed flight (e.g., gift card or credit card).

rule_list.description: When gesture certificate is offered under the 100 USD per passenger policy, set the amount to 100 USD per passenger.
predicates: Gesture certificate has been offered to the user.
Policy indicating the certificate amount is USD 100 per passenger.
Set the certificate amount to 100 USD per passenger.

rule_list.description: When gesture certificate is offered under the 50x policy, set total amount to 50 times the number of passengers.
predicates: Gesture certificate has been offered to the user.
Policy indicating the certificate amount is 50 times the number of passengers.
Action to set the total certificate amount to 50 times the number of passengers when the 50x policy applies.

rule_list.description: Policy: The remaining amount of a travel certificate is nonrefundable. If a refund is initiated for a transaction paid with a travel certificate that has a nonzero remaining balance, the refund must be denied.
predicates: A refund has been initiated for a customer.
An action where the agent applies a travel certificate to the current reservation's payment.
The travel certificate used for the transaction has a nonzero remaining balance.
The refund for the travel certificate's remaining balance is denied.
rule_list.logic: ALWAYS ((refund_initiated AND travel_certificate_applied_to_current_reservation_payment AND remaining_certificate_balance_nonzero) IMPLIES refund_denied)

rule_list.description: If a refund is initiated, it should complete within 5-7 business days after initiation.
predicates: A refund has been initiated for a customer.
The refund completes within 5 to 7 business days from initiation.

rule_list.description: Cabin class must be identical across all flights in the same reservation.
predicates: All flight segments in the reservation share the same cabin class.

rule_list.description: If any segment has been flown, a transfer is needed and the trip cannot be canceled.
predicates: There exists at least one segment in the trip that has been flown.
The system requires transferring the passenger due to flown segment(s).
The agent may cancel the entire trip, discarding all remaining segments.

rule_list.description: Enforces that at most one credit card payment occurs until the reservation is finalized.
predicates: An event indicating that a payment was made using a credit card for the current reservation.
State indicating that the reservation payment process has been completed.
rule_list.logic: ALWAYS( credit_card_payment_made IMPLIES NEXT( (NOT credit_card_payment_made) UNTIL reservation_finalized ) )

rule_list.description: If a payment for a reservation starts, the system must eventually complete the payment for that reservation successfully.
predicates: A payment transaction for a reservation has started (or is in progress).
A payment transaction for a reservation has completed successfully.

rule_list.description: If a reservation payment is in progress and not yet completed, the fourth gift card must not be applied to enforce a maximum of three gift cards per payment.
predicates: A payment transaction for a reservation has started (or is in progress).
The payment transaction for the reservation completed successfully.
Indicates that the fourth gift card has been applied to the current payment for a reservation.

rule_list.description: If the customer request is not within scope, transfer to a human agent for assistance.
predicates: Whether the current user request can be resolved within the agent's defined scope and capabilities.
The agent transfers the user to a human agent for assistance.

rule_list.description: If the request is within scope, the agent should not transfer to a human agent.
predicates: Whether the current user request can be resolved within the agent's defined scope and capabilities.
The agent transfers the user to a human agent for assistance.

rule_list.description: All payment methods used must already be stored in the user's profile for safety.
predicates: The agent selects or attempts to use a specific payment method for a transaction.
The user's profile includes payment method details and the currently selected payment method is stored in the profile.

rule_list.description: Remover of checked bags is prohibited at all times.
predicates: Action where a checked bag is removed from the flight order.

rule_list.description: The user is not allowed to add insurance after the initial booking has been completed.
predicates: Action where the user adds insurance to a booking.
Indicates that the initial flight booking has been completed.

rule_list.description: The user's profile must contain all required fields: user_id, email, addresses, date of birth, payment method details, reservation numbers, and membership tier.
predicates: The user's profile includes all required fields: user_id, email, addresses, date of birth, payment method details, reservation numbers, and membership tier.

rule_list.description: If a reservation includes multiple passengers, the total number of passengers must be within the limit of five.
predicates: Indicates that the current reservation includes more than one passenger.
Total number of passengers in the current reservation is less than or equal to five.

rule_list.description: Cabin class must be identical across all flight segments within the same reservation. If the reservation contains at least two segments, the cabin for all segments must match the cabin for the first segment.
predicates: Indicates that the reservation contains two or more flight segments.
All flight segments in the reservation share the same cabin class.

rule_list.description: For every passenger in the reservation creation process, the agent must eventually collect the passenger's first name, last name, and date of birth.
predicates: There is a passenger currently being added to the reservation creation workflow.
Agent collects the passenger's first name, last name, and date of birth.

rule_list.description: If the count exceeds five, completion of booking is prohibited.
predicates: Total number of passengers in the current reservation is less than or equal to five.
Action to finalize the reservation booking.

rule_list.description: Business-class flights can be cancelled per policy.
predicates: Cancellation of a business-class flight is permitted by policy.

rule_list.description: If flight status is delayed or on time, booking is not allowed and booking is blocked by policy.
predicates: The flight status is on time.
Indicates whether the flight can be booked given current conditions (true if booking is possible).
Booking is blocked due to policy.
rule_list.logic: (flight_status_delayed OR flight_status_on_time) IMPLIES (NOT can_be_booked AND booking_blocked)

rule_list.description: If the flight is available for sale, there are seats available and prices are listed.
predicates: The flight status is 'available' (open for sale).
There are seats available for sale on the flight.
Prices for seats for a specific flight are listed.

rule_list.description: If the flight status is on time or delayed, the flight has not departed yet.
predicates: The flight status is on time.

rule_list.description: If the flight has not departed yet and seats are available, booking is possible for this flight.
predicates: There are seats available for sale on the flight.
Indicates whether the flight can be booked given current conditions (true if booking is possible).
rule_list.logic: NOT flight_departed AND seats_available IMPLIES can_be_booked

rule_list.description: If the flight has departed, it cannot be booked.
predicates: Indicates whether the flight can be booked given current conditions (true if booking is possible).

rule_list.description: The API call to modify a flight is allowed only when authorization, valid flight ID, existing flight, approved modification obtained, and both user ID and reservation ID have been obtained before the API call.
predicates: The agent has performed (made) the API call to modify a flight.
Agent has explicit permission to modify flight records.
Flight ID matches the IATA flight number format: two uppercase letters followed by 1-4 digits (e.g., AA123)
The flight identifier provided exists in the system
There exists an approved change request for the target flight modification and approval has been obtained prior to the API call.
Both the user ID and the reservation ID have been obtained before the modify flight API call.
rule_list.logic: modify_flight_api_call_made IMPLIES (is_authorized_to_modify_flight AND flight_id_is_iata_flight_number AND flight_id_exists AND flight_modification_approval_obtained AND ids_obtained_before_api_call)

rule_list.description: Equivalence: Booking update is allowed if prerequisites have been met; also, if prerequisites have been met then a booking update is allowed.
predicates: Merged action representing any update to the booking database (flight booking, passenger details, segments, times, core details).
The prerequisites for performing a booking update have been satisfied, i.e., the update details have been listed to the user and the user has explicitly confirmed to proceed.
rule_list.logic: pre_update_requirements_met IMPLIES update_booking_action AND update_booking_action IMPLIES pre_update_requirements_met

rule_list.description: Gold members have 2 free checked bags for basic economy passengers.
predicates: Booking user belongs to the gold member tier.
Passenger is in the basic economy category.
Gold member entitlement for 2 free checked bags when the passenger is in basic economy.

rule_list.description: Gold members have 3 free checked bags for economy passengers.
predicates: Booking user belongs to the gold member tier.
Passenger is in the economy category.
Entitlement of 3 free checked bags for economy passengers for gold members.

rule_list.description: Regular members have 0 free checked bags for basic economy.
predicates: Booking user belongs to the regular member tier.
Passenger is in the basic economy category.
Entitlement indicating the number of free checked bags for regular members booking basic economy (0 bags).

rule_list.description: Gold members have 3 free checked bags for business passengers.
predicates: Booking user belongs to the gold member tier.
Passenger is in the business class.
Entitlement that the member is entitled to 3 free checked bags for business-class passengers.

rule_list.description: Regular members have 1 free checked bag for economy passengers.
predicates: Booking user belongs to the regular member tier.
Passenger is in the economy category.
Entitlement indicating that regular members have 1 free checked bag for economy passengers.

rule_list.description: Regular members have 2 free checked bags for business passengers.
predicates: Booking user belongs to the regular member tier.
Passenger is in the business class.
Entitlement indicating that regular members have 2 free checked bags for business passengers.

rule_list.description: Silver members have 1 free checked bag for basic economy passengers.
predicates: Booking user belongs to the silver member tier.
Passenger is in the basic economy category.
Entitlement granting one free checked bag for silver members traveling in basic economy.

rule_list.description: Silver members have 2 free checked bags for economy passengers.
predicates: Booking user belongs to the silver member tier.
Passenger is in the economy category.
Entitlement of 2 free checked bags for economy passengers for silver members.

rule_list.description: Silver members have 3 free checked bags for business passengers.
predicates: Booking user belongs to the silver member tier.
Passenger is in the business class.
Entitlement that silver members have 3 free checked bags for business passengers.

rule_list.description: Active reservations must have a non-null user_id and passenger information.
predicates: There exists an active reservation in the current system/context.
The active reservation has a non-null user_id.
The active reservation contains passenger information.

rule_list.description: A travel certificate may be used only if there is an active reservation.
predicates: An action where the agent applies a travel certificate to the current reservation's payment.
There exists an active reservation in the current system/context.

rule_list.description: If a cancellation occurs due to health or weather and travel insurance is present for this booking, a full refund should eventually be granted for this booking.
predicates: Cancellation due to health or weather reasons.
The current reservation contains travel insurance information.
A full refund has been granted for the specified booking.
rule_list.logic: ALWAYS ((cancellation_due_to_health_or_weather AND travel_insurance_present) IMPLIES EVENTUALLY full_refund_granted_for_booking)

rule_list.description: If a reservation context is present, the context must be complete with ID, flights, travel insurance, payment methods, baggage info, a created_time timestamp, and a valid trip type.
predicates: A reservation context is present in the system for evaluation.
A complete reservation context including ID, flights, travelInsurance, payment methods, baggage, created_time, and valid trip_type is present.

rule_list.description: Offer a gesture certificate when the user is a gold or silver member, or travel insurance is present, or flies in business class, and the user has a cancelled flight complaint with facts confirmed.
predicates: Booking user belongs to the gold member tier.
Booking user belongs to the silver member tier.
The current reservation contains travel insurance information.
User has a complaint about cancelled flights in their reservation.
Facts about the user's flight and complaint have been confirmed.
Gesture certificate has been offered to the user.
rule_list.logic: ALWAYS (((is_member_gold OR is_member_silver OR travel_insurance_present OR flies_in_business_class) AND has_cancelled_flight_complaint AND facts_confirmed) IMPLIES gesture_certificate_offered)
